judged_text: BiginCalendarService passes `credentialId` — the credential row identifier — as the userId argument to refreshOAuthTokens, which sends it as calcomUserId to the sync endpoint, while every sibling call site passes credential.userId. The parent application receives the credential's database id where the contract (app-credential.ts: 'UserId of the cal.com user') requires the Cal.com user id, so it resolves the wrong user's tokens (or none) and the wrong user's credentials get synced back into this credential.

The parent application receives the credential's database id where the contract (app-credential.ts: 'UserId of the cal.com user') requires the Cal.com user id, so it resolves the wrong user's tokens (or none) and the wrong user's credentials get synced back into this credential.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new call `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)` passes `credentialId` as the third argument. The helper `refreshOAuthTokens` treats that argument as `userId` and sends it to the sync endpoint as `calcomUserId` (`body: new URLSearchParams({ calcomUserId: userId.toString(), appSlug })`). Sibling call sites in the diff consistently pass `credential.userId` (e.g., Hubspot/Lark/Zoom/Webex). Given the contract in `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts` expects `userId` to be the Cal.com user id, passing a credential row id would cause the sync endpoint to resolve the wrong user (or none), leading to incorrect token refresh/sync behavior.
